modelspec.observatory.GraphEdge.title: GraphEdge
modelspec.observatory.GraphEdge.description: One tensor flowing from the node that defines it to a node that reads it; its dtype and shape are its producer's (DESIGN.md § 3.2 TensorNode.operands).

producer.description: value_id of the node defining the tensor.

consumer.description: value_id of the node reading it.

operand.description: The position of the tensor among the consumer's operands, from 0; operand order matters (Sub, MatMul).
